_comment: Hoodrich dealers -- the people you buy BULK from. Bulk cannot be sold until it has been
cut and bagged (wheel > Drugs > Cut).
Dealers are real peds standing in the world, not a phone menu. WHERE they stand is a list
of GET_NAME_OF_ZONE codes, never coordinates, so nothing here can drop a ped through the
map. A gang dealer with an empty 'zones' list stands wherever his crew holds turf, read
live from gangs.json.
You can also phone a dealer out to meet you, but that only saves you finding them -- you
still drive to the rendezvous and stand in front of them to trade.
THE PROGRESSION: you can only buy from your own crew's corner dealer. Once you have moved
enough weight (Economy > DocksUnlockGrams in Hoodrich.ini, default 50g), the 'Ask source'
option on his page works and he names the port -- which is what makes the dock worker, and
with him the whole catalogue in bulk, exist for you.
kind             GangCorner | Docks
gangId           which crew a corner dealer runs with
drugs            what they sell. EMPTY means the whole catalogue -- that is the docks.
zones            GET_NAME_OF_ZONE codes they stand in; empty on a gang dealer = his turf
models           ped models tried IN ORDER; first one present in your install wins
priceMultiplier  applied to the wholesale price. Below 1.0 is a better deal.
openHour/closeHour  operating hours, 0-24. Wraps midnight when open > close.
greeting / buyLine / sourceReply / sourceTooSoon / farewell  what they say to you

dealers.name: Lil' Marcus
dealers.greeting: You good? Green's what I got, don't ask for nothin' else.
dealers.buyLine: Say how much and don't stand there lookin' at me.
dealers.sourceReply: Man... the boat. Down the port, Elysian. Dock boy pulls it off the containers before it's counted. Tell him Marcus sent you and don't waste his time.
dealers.sourceTooSoon: You moved what, an ounce? Come back when you're worth talkin' to.

dealers.name: Big Slime
dealers.greeting: You ain't from round here. Talk fast.
dealers.buyLine: Rock's rock. How much you want?
dealers.sourceReply: Port. Elysian Island. There's a dock hand down there movin' weight off the containers. He don't know you, so don't act like he does.
dealers.sourceTooSoon: Nah. You ain't moved enough for me to be tellin' you nothin'.

dealers.name: Chuy
dealers.greeting: Que onda. You buying or you lost?
dealers.sourceReply: Comes off the water, homie. Port of LS, Elysian. Ask for the dock guy, he handles the containers. He'll sort you out with weight.
dealers.sourceTooSoon: You barely moved anything. Come back when you're serious.

dealers.name: Wrench
dealers.greeting: You lost? 'Cause I'm Lost. That's the joke. What do you want.
dealers.sourceReply: Ha. You want the tap, not the cup. Port of LS, Elysian Island. Dock worker down there gets it all off the boats. Everything, not just my stuff.
dealers.sourceTooSoon: You've shifted nothin'. Ask me again when that changes.

dealers.name: Mr. Kwan
dealers.greeting: You are early or you are late. Which is it.
dealers.sourceReply: It arrives by sea, like everything. Elysian Island, the port. There is a man on the docks who counts containers badly, on purpose. Speak to him.
dealers.sourceTooSoon: You have moved almost nothing. We will speak again when you have.

dealers.name: Vartan
dealers.greeting: You want something, or you want to stand there.
dealers.sourceReply: Off the boat, where else. Port of Los Santos, Elysian Island. There is a dock worker. He takes his cut before the manifest. He can get you anything.
dealers.sourceTooSoon: You have moved nothing worth counting. Come back.

dealers.name: Dock Worker
dealers.greeting: Marcus's people, right? Keep it quiet and keep it quick. Whatever's in the box, I can get it off the box.
dealers.buyLine: Anything you want, in weight. Say what and say how much.
dealers.sourceReply: Where do I get it? Mate, I AM where you get it.
dealers.farewell: Off you go. Don't come back in daylight if you're carrying.
